tasks.title: Create, revoke and redeem single-use invitation links with anonymous form protection
tasks.spec: Repository: console, invitation slice of Behavior, Checks and Documentation; Required behavior 2-4, 8-10, 19 and 21; Acceptance evidence 2 rows 14-15, invite/revoke routes of 3, 4, invite cases of 4a, 4b, invited-Admin/switch cases of 6, invite events/rollback of 8, invite pages of 11 and invite half of 12; invitation-related Counterexamples and Security impact. This is the entire invitation lifecycle, including pending-list rendering and per-invite action links using shared plain confirmation. Implement random 32-byte base64url tokens, SHA-256 digests, raw-path matching, configured/checked loopback origin, email normalization, duplicate/live-invite rules and issuer authority. Use existing s: form tokens for team POSTs and a: tokens with anonymous-cookie CSRF for public POSTs; preserve section 3 precedence: link lookup before form token and KDF, successful POST replay 404, still-live used-form-token replay 409 linking only to /sign-in. At this first mutating task add PageRequest.sessionId in protected-route.ts and populate it from signedIn.id in server.ts without changing dispatcher order. Define the shared CredentialGuard type in factor-store.ts now (the account guarded methods follow in T4). Every create/revoke team-store operation takes { sessionId, userId } and starts its BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction by checking that session digest and actor user_id still exist, before re-reading actor authority, invite/target, revision where applicable and rule. A missing session returns session-gone, mapped to shell 409 Not saved with the exact section 3 error, role=alert and Reload target; no mutation, People event, link, team-change log or cookie change. Add store regression coverage plus an HTTP request admitted before its session is revoked while its body is incomplete, using the existing sign-out-all route as the intervening change; then finish that body and assert the commit refusal. A cookie already revoked before dispatch instead keeps the existing 303 sign-in gate. Extend the same contract in T3/T4. Revalidate authority and invite/email state in the atomic commit with its People event; hash only after field/form checks. Successful anonymous acceptance does not use the issuing actor's session guard; it revalidates the invite/issuer as section 10 specifies. Start full or enrol sessions with the existing #563 policy, rotating an existing cookie only after invite commit. Public validation never depends on a session cookie. Extend the real production startup test for unknown invite links; add reset coverage when T4 registers that route. Include per-flow logs/metrics redaction, no-script forms, CSP/no-store headers, narrow layout/browser assertions and docs without adding SMTP, a copy script, a second shell or a second token system.

tasks.title: Enforce team target rules for role changes, removal, 2FA reset and ownership transfer
tasks.spec: Repository: console, team-administration slice of Behavior, Checks and Documentation; Required behavior 2-5, 7-9, 12-15, 20-21; Acceptance evidence 2 rows 16-19 and 23-25 plus team.require-2fa, corresponding routes of 3, promoted-Admin/switch/administrative-reset cases of 6, 7, applicable events/rollback/scans of 8, removal page of 11; target/id/stale-state/transfer/removal/form-budget Counterexamples. Implement these operations together because each uses the same actor/target authorization, revision, shared confirmations and BEGIN IMMEDIATE recheck with atomic People event. Reuse T2's CredentialGuard and PageRequest.sessionId for every new POST /team/*: session row first, re-read actor second, target lookup, revision, then target rule, all in the same transaction. session-gone is the exact 409 Not saved page with no row/event/link/team-change log, before any role-based 403; a concurrent transfer whose first commit revoked both sessions makes the second commit 409, leaving one Owner. Keep per-operation store tests green for both a present and a deleted actor session. Do not implement reset-link issuance until the complete reset lifecycle in T4. Nobody acts on Owner or self; only Owner changes any role or acts on Admin. Validate decimal ids and revision=<created_at>-<role>, checking format, lookup, target authority, revision and typed name in the specified order after dispatcher form-token consumption. Removal uses the exact API-token-survival warning, preserves history and invalidates cascaded sessions/factors/links plus issuer-bound invites. Role changes end every target session. Transfer requires an enrolled Admin, demotes former Owner first, leaves exactly one Owner, ends both people's sessions including requester and clears cookie with 303 /sign-in?transfer=done. Add the Owner-only organisation switch using the existing live predicate, ending no sessions. Keep action links per person rather than row forms; test 60 users. Add per-operation HTTP tests, authorization inventory, rollback/concurrency cases, events, docs and responsive/no-JavaScript shared-confirmation coverage. The complete HTTP held-body acceptance 5b suite lands in T4, once reset-link issuance/redemption exists; do not weaken the session checks while waiting for those integration scenarios.

tasks.title: Reset and change passwords while rejecting stale sign-in and account writes atomically
tasks.spec: Repository: console, password/credential slice of Behavior and Order of work; Required behavior 3, 7-8, 11, 16-17, 19 and 21; Acceptance evidence 2 rows 20-22 and 27, remaining account/reset routes of 3, reset cases of 4a/4b, 5, ALL of 5a and 5b, applicable events/scans of 8, password/reset pages of 11 and completed 12; credential/CSRF/replay/reset Counterexamples and Security impact. Build the entire team reset-link lifecycle and own-password flow together with verified-hash sign-in rotation and guarded #563 writes; these share the credential/session transaction boundary and deterministic gated fakes. Team reset links are digest-only, valid 86400000 ms, issuer/target-role-bound, replaced on reissue, once; redemption revokes all target sessions and other unused links, keeps TOTP/recovery codes and starts no session. Include owner-recovery-kind redemption in the common reset logic for T5, clearing factors and recording owner.recover only for that kind. Use the public ordering of section 3 and shared link primitives: anonymous CSRF, a: token, invalid-link-first replay precedence and revalidation after hash. Own password uses recheckPassword, s: token, compare-and-set on session and H0, ends other sessions and writes its People event; pending reset link stays valid. Sign-in adds account-store.inImmediateTransaction(work) and rotates/deletes/inserts inside it through ctx.deps.store.deleteSession, deleteExpiredSessions, userById and createSession in the section 17 order. A stale hash or absent user rolls back even the old-cookie/expired-row deletions and returns counted 401 with Wrong email or password., reason credentials and no session set-cookie. A throw of an injected store method rolls back and releases the throttle reservation as before. The existing Proxy at server.sign-in.test.ts:75-88 and all three throttle failure-injection tests at :317-329 keep their code and expectations unchanged: six 500 responses for each failing method, then 303 after restoring it. Do not bypass these method calls. Extend the CredentialGuard introduced in T2 with its passwordHash check and add replaceRecoveryCodesFor, savePendingAuthenticatorFor and deleteOtherSessionsFor without changing the unguarded APIs/tests; switch all three routes to guarded writes and exact 409 answers with no leaked codes. Authenticator setup race uses action=new, not start. Cover full/enrol guards, session/hash changed or present and retain second-factor commit behavior. Complete real startup wiring tests for both link routes, notices, metrics, docs and browser cases alongside implementation. Reset-link issuance reuses the team session-first transaction guard, whereas anonymous reset redemption checks the bearer link independently of cookies. Add ALL four exact held-body scenarios and the control of acceptance 5b in server.team.test.ts now: invite during Admin 2FA reset, reset-link issuance during actor demotion, removal during actor password reset, and require-2fa during Owner sign-out-all. Use raw incomplete request bodies and explicit completion with no timers; verify no forbidden mutation, People event, link or team-change log. The demotion case is 409 rather than 403 because session-gone wins.
